answer: Harbor clerks issue one berth at Willow Inlet every 16 days. The applicant posts 12,800 tokens and hangs a unique silvered mirror, serial MI-9021, on that berth's piling; a numbered fiber thread is drawn through the frame and a dock ring, then resin-potted so the thread length and twist are a committed measurement. For 8 days, a shore theodolite records the mirror's reflection of a dated tide staff. Audit fails, and 7,400 tokens burn with an 8-epoch ban, if the serial, thread assay, or staff digits were seen in any prior 70-day file, or if the reflection is swapped. One berth, one graduate.
